## Results
- Key table/figure (single most persuasive visual)
    - add 95% confidence intervals for the standardized regression coefficients

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-key
#| fig-showtext: true
#| fig.width: 12
#| fig.height: 6
#| out.width: "100%"

library(tidyverse)
library(showtext)

font_add_google("League Gothic", "League Gothic")
font_add_google("Source Sans 3", "source_sans")
showtext_auto()

# 1. Base dataset
dat <- data.frame(
  stat = factor(
    c("3P%", "TS%", "USG%", "TRB", "AST", "BLK", "TOV", "PTS"),
    levels = rev(c("3P%", "TS%", "USG%", "TRB", "AST", "BLK", "TOV", "PTS"))
  ),
  Salary = sample(-1:1, 8, replace = TRUE),
  VORP   = sample(-1:1, 8, replace = TRUE)
)

# 2. Reshape to long format for automatic color aesthetic mapping
dat_long <- dat %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Salary, VORP), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Coefficient")

# Custom colors matching your palette
metric_colors <- c("Salary" = "#00bfa5", "VORP" = "#c62828")

# 3. Plot with native dot legend under title
ggplot() +
  # Connecting gray segment (uses wide dataset)
  geom_segment(
    data = dat,
    aes(x = Salary, xend = VORP, y = stat, yend = stat),
    color = "#e0e0e0", linewidth = 2, lineend = "round"
  ) +
  # Points mapped to 'Metric' for automatic legend generation
  geom_point(
    data = dat_long,
    aes(x = Coefficient, y = stat, color = Metric),
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  # Text labels for Salary
  geom_text(
    data = dat,
    aes(x = Salary, y = stat, label = sprintf("%.2f", Salary)),
    color = metric_colors["Salary"],
    hjust = ifelse(dat$Salary < dat$VORP, 1.4, -0.4),
    size = 3.8, family = "source_sans", fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  # Text labels for VORP
  geom_text(
    data = dat,
    aes(x = VORP, y = stat, label = sprintf("%.2f", VORP)),
    color = metric_colors["VORP"],
    size = 3.8, family = "source_sans", fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  # Custom manual color scale
  scale_color_manual(values = metric_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.2)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  # Standardize legend aesthetic key size (dot glyphs)
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4))) +
  labs(
    title = "Standardized Regression Coefficients for Box Score on Salary and VORP",
    subtitle = "When VORP is greater than salary, the player statistic is relatively undervalued in the market.\nWhen VORP is less than salary, the player statistic is relatively overvalued in the market.",
    x = NULL, y = NULL, color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(
      family = "League Gothic", face = "bold", size = 28, margin = margin(b = 4)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      family = "source_sans", color = "#333333", size = 13, margin = margin(b = 10), lineheight = 0.95
    ),
    # Legend position and layout under the title/subtitle
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.text = element_text(family = "source_sans", face = "bold", size = 12, color = "#333333"),
    legend.margin = margin(t = 0, b = 15),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#e5e5e5", linetype = "dotted"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(family = "source_sans", face = "bold", color = "#333333"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(family = "source_sans", color = "#777777")
  )
```
